cues.en: Polynomial is a category of functions that basically just involves raising the independent variable x to higher powers and multiplying by some coefficient.
cues.zh: 多項式是一類函數，基本上就是把自變數 x 取較高次方，再乘某個係數。

cues.en: In this video you will learn the definition of polynomial functions, some important terminology like order and coefficients.
cues.zh: 這支會學多項式函數的定義，以及次數、係數等重要術語。

cues.en: I'll talk a little bit about working with polynomials and rational functions and also why polynomials are important in math, in particular in applied mathematics.
cues.zh: 也會談多項式的操作、有理函數，以及多項式在數學，尤其應用數學，為什麼重要。

cues.en: Polynomials are really simple.
cues.zh: 多項式很簡單。

cues.en: You just take the variable x and raise it to higher and higher powers.
cues.zh: 就是讓 x 的次方越來越高。

cues.en: Multiply by some coefficient and sum all of those terms together.
cues.zh: 乘上某個係數，再把所有項加起來。

cues.en: So this is the general form of a polynomial.
cues.zh: 這是多項式的一般形式。

cues.en: You can see the x is raised to higher powers and the A's here are called the coefficients.
cues.zh: x 取不同的較高次方，這些 a 就叫係數。

cues.en: Here's the spelling of coefficient.
cues.zh: coefficient 就是這樣拼。

cues.en: Now it looks like there's no x term here, but actually to complete the pattern you would write x to the one over here and then this is x to the zero.
cues.zh: 這裡看似沒有 x，但為了完整呈現規律，可以在這裡寫 x¹，再在這裡寫 x⁰。

cues.en: But of course X to the power of zero is just one, so it's generally left out.
cues.zh: 當然，x 的零次方是一，所以通常省略。

cues.en: By the way, this first term is sometimes called the intercept of the equation.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，第一項有時叫方程式的截距。

cues.en: It's called that because that's the value of Y.
cues.zh: 因為它是 y 的值，

cues.en: When all of the X's are set to zero, that will be more clear in a few slides when I show the graphs of polynomials.
cues.zh: 當所有 x 設成零時；幾張投影片後看到多項式圖形，就會更清楚。

cues.en: Anyway, you can summarize this kind of expression more compactly using the summation notation.
cues.zh: 總之，可以用求和記號，更精簡地表示這種運算式。

cues.en: So this PN here, which is the highest power the X gets raised to, is called the order of the polynomial.
cues.zh: 這裡的 n，也就是 x 的最高次方，稱為多項式的次數。

cues.en: So this is an nth order polynomial.
cues.zh: 所以這是 n 次多項式。

cues.en: Here you see two examples of polynomials.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩個例子。

cues.en: Now what are the orders of these polynomials?
cues.zh: 它們各是幾次？

cues.en: Feel free to pause the video if you need a moment to think about it.
cues.zh: 如果需要時間思考，可以暫停。

cues.en: The answer is that both of these functions are third order polynomials.
cues.zh: 答案是，兩個都是三次多項式。

cues.en: Now, it might seem a little confusing because this one only has two terms, but you don't actually need to have all of the powers in the equation.
cues.zh: 可能有點困惑，因為這個只有兩項，但方程式不必出現所有次方。

cues.en: You can imagine writing out all the other terms.
cues.zh: 可以想像把其他項寫出來。

cues.en: So x squared, for example, and setting the coefficient to be zero.
cues.zh: 例如 x²，再把係數設成零。

cues.en: Again, this is a third order polynomial because the highest power is three.
cues.zh: 再說一次，這是三次多項式，因為最高次方是三。

cues.en: It doesn't matter how many lower power terms have non-zero coefficients.
cues.zh: 不管較低次方有多少項係數非零。

cues.en: This is an nth a third order polynomial.
cues.zh: 它仍是三次多項式。

cues.en: Also notice that an nth order polynomial has n plus one coefficient.
cues.zh: 也注意，n 次多項式有 n+1 個係數。

cues.en: So this is a third order polynomial.
cues.zh: 這是三次。

cues.en: And there are one, two, three four coefficients.
cues.zh: 有一、二、三、四個係數。

cues.en: So an nth order polynomial has n plus one coefficients and the plus one comes from the x term here, which is x to the power of zero.
cues.zh: 所以 n 次有 n+1 個係數，多的一個，來自這裡的 x⁰ 項。

cues.en: So here you see some graphs of polynomials of different orders.
cues.zh: 這裡有不同次數多項式的圖。

cues.en: Let's start with this one.
cues.zh: 先看這個。

cues.en: A zero order polynomial is of course just a flat line.
cues.zh: 零次多項式當然就是水平線。

cues.en: X to the power of zero is one.
cues.zh: x⁰ 是一。

cues.en: So the intercept of this line where it crosses the y axis when x equals zero is here set to one.
cues.zh: 所以這條線在 x=0 與 y 軸相交的截距，這裡設成一。

cues.en: And so then if there is a multiplication by a coefficient, then the intercept is whatever the coefficient is.
cues.zh: 若再乘係數，截距就等於那個係數。

cues.en: So this is just a constant, a polynomial of zero order.
cues.zh: 所以只是常數，零次多項式。

cues.en: And once you start getting into the higher powers, then the graphs have like this kind of nice alternating look to them.
cues.zh: 次數越來越高，圖形就呈現這種有趣的交替外觀。

cues.en: In particular, the even ordered polynomials here and here are symmetric, whereas the odd polynomial.
cues.zh: 尤其這裡、這裡的偶次多項式是對稱的，而奇次多項式，

cues.en: So here, here and here have this kind of neat asymmetric pattern.
cues.zh: 這裡、這裡和這裡，則有這種有趣的不對稱模式。

cues.en: They have this asymmetry to them.
cues.zh: 它們不對稱。

cues.en: And this happens because even powered polynomials cannot be negative, whereas odd ordered polynomials can be negative.
cues.zh: 因為偶次多項式不能是負，奇次多項式則可以。

cues.en: Of course, this function could in principle be negative.
cues.zh: 當然，這個函數原則上也能是負。

cues.en: If you just say minus x squared, that would be entirely negative.
cues.zh: 如果寫 −x²，就會全部是負的。

cues.en: But otherwise the polynomials of an even order have a nice left right symmetry.
cues.zh: 除此之外，偶次多項式有漂亮的左右對稱。

cues.en: In fact, this pattern of symmetry and anti symmetry has a name in math.
cues.zh: 其實這種對稱、反對稱的模式，在數學有名稱。

cues.en: These are called even functions and these are called odd functions.
cues.zh: 這些叫偶函數，這些叫奇函數。

cues.en: Even functions are mirrored across the x equals zero line, whereas odd functions are mirrored but are negative.
cues.zh: 偶函數以 x=0 這條線鏡射，奇函數則鏡射後還要取負。

cues.en: Now it's actually a more formal definition of even an odd function that's related to function symmetry.
cues.zh: 奇偶函數其實有更正式的定義，和函數對稱性有關。

cues.en: And I'm going to define that in a later video in this section, the entire video just on that concept.
cues.zh: 本節後面會有完整一支影片定義這個概念。

cues.en: But it's important for you to be familiar with the graphs of polynomials raised to even or odd powers.
cues.zh: 不過，熟悉偶次或奇次冪的多項式圖形，很重要。

cues.en: Another intuition about polynomials is that the graph of the function and therefore also the behavior
cues.zh: 多項式的另一個直覺，是函數圖形，因此也是，

cues.en: of the function is generally dominated by whatever is the highest power term and that you see here.
cues.zh: 函數行為，通常由最高次項主導，這裡就能看到。

cues.en: So even though I'm adding a square and a cube, the cube is a higher power.
cues.zh: 雖然把平方和立方相加，但立方次數更高。

cues.en: And so it dominates this function.
cues.zh: 所以主導這個函數。

cues.en: Certainly as X gets further away from zero, of course, you know, this all depends somewhat on the coefficients.
cues.zh: 尤其 x 遠離零時；當然，也取決於係數。

cues.en: If the coefficient of the x cubed term is tiny relative to the coefficient on the square term, then x the x squared term will dominate the graph when x is small.
cues.zh: 如果三次項係數相對平方項非常小，那 x 小的時候，會由平方項主導圖形。

cues.en: But if you zoom out then you move towards infinity.
cues.zh: 但縮小觀看尺度，往無窮遠走。

cues.en: So you just zoom out on the x axis, you increase the domain here, then you will see that the largest power term eventually always comes to dominate the function and that you see here, this is exactly
cues.zh: 也就是把 x 軸拉遠、擴大這裡的定義域，就會看到最高次項最後總會主導函數；這裡是完全，

cues.en: the same function.
cues.zh: 相同的函數。

cues.en: Apologies for the overlap here is exactly the same function.
cues.zh: 抱歉，這裡有重疊，是完全相同的函數。

cues.en: All I've done is zoomed out on the x axis.
cues.zh: 我只是把 x 軸視野拉遠。

cues.en: So this goes from x minus two to plus two.
cues.zh: 這邊 x 從負二到正二。

cues.en: Here we have x -200 to.
cues.zh: 這邊從負 200 到，

cues.en: Plus to Andre.
So in general, the largest order term is going to dominate the graph regardless of the coefficients
cues.zh: 所以一般而言，最高次項會主導圖形，不論係數如何，

cues.en: as you tend towards minus infinity and plus infinity.
cues.zh: 當你往負無窮、正無窮靠近時。

cues.en: I have previously mentioned that this coefficient without an ex term or technically there is an x term here, but is x to the power of zero.
cues.zh: 前面提過，這個沒有 x 的係數，嚴格來說有 x，不過是 x⁰。

cues.en: This is called the intercept of the polynomial and the interpretation is that the intercept is the value
cues.zh: 叫多項式的截距，意思就是，

cues.en: of the function when x equals zero.
cues.zh: x=0 時的函數值。

cues.en: That's pretty clear from looking at the function itself.
cues.zh: 看函數本身就很清楚。

cues.en: So you set x to zero and then you find y equals two.
cues.zh: 把 x 設為零，得到 y=2。

cues.en: And it's also clear from the graph here, when x is zero, Y is in this case it equals two.
cues.zh: 圖上也很清楚，x=0 時，y 這裡等於二。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Now I'd like to walk you through arithmetic with polynomials.
cues.zh: 現在帶你做多項式四則運算。

cues.en: Now, I'm pretty sure that as I go through the next few slides, you will recognize or already know what I'm going to say.
cues.zh: 我想接下來幾張的內容，你應該已經知道或認得。

cues.en: But polynomial arithmetic comes up a lot in calculus, and so I want to make sure we're all on the same page.
cues.zh: 不過微積分很常用，所以要確保大家理解一致。

cues.en: First, let's talk about addition and therefore also subtraction.
cues.zh: 先談加法，因此也包括減法。

cues.en: So I encourage you to pause video and solve this equation here.
cues.zh: 鼓勵你暫停，解這個式子。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: Did you figure it out?
cues.zh: 解出來了嗎？

cues.en: So the key thing to know about adding polynomials is that you can only add terms if they are raised to the same power.
cues.zh: 多項式加法的關鍵，是只有相同次方的項才能合併。

cues.en: So the minus five and the and the two here can be added together because they are both X to the power of one.
cues.zh: 所以這裡負五和二能相加，因為都乘 x¹。

cues.en: And so that gives us minus three X.
cues.zh: 得到 −3x。

cues.en: And then here these two terms can be added together because they contain X to the power of three.
cues.zh: 這兩項也能相加，因為都含 x³。

cues.en: You cannot add this term to this term because the X is are raised to different powers.
cues.zh: 這項不能和那項合併，因為 x 的次方不同。

cues.en: Okay, So let's see.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So here's the final answer in case you want to check your work.
cues.zh: 這裡是最後答案，供核對。

cues.en: So that's about adding and subtracting polynomials.
cues.zh: 以上是多項式加減。

cues.en: Next we get to multiplication.
cues.zh: 接著乘法。

cues.en: And before showing an example with polynomials, I want to remind you of something called the Law of Exponents.
cues.zh: 在多項式範例之前，先提醒指數律。

cues.en: It sounds very fancy because it's a law, but the law of exponents is pretty straightforward when you multiply to like terms.
cues.zh: 聽起來很厲害，因為叫法則，但其實很直接，乘上相同底數的項時，

cues.en: So the bases are the same, then their exponents will sum.
cues.zh: 底數相同，指數就相加。

cues.en: So here you can sum A and B because the base is the same, but you cannot sum this A here because the base is different.
cues.zh: 這裡能把 a 和 b 相加，因為底數相同；但這裡的 a 不能，因為底數不同。

cues.en: So with that in mind, I would like you to pause the video and have a go at this one.
cues.zh: 記住這點，暫停試試這題。

cues.en: So solve this equation here, multiply these two terms.
cues.zh: 解這個式子，把兩項相乘。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So did you get an answer?
cues.zh: 有答案了嗎？

cues.en: Well, these kinds of polynomial multiplications, they're not really difficult per se, but they do get tedious.
cues.zh: 這種多項式乘法不是真的難，但會很繁瑣。

cues.en: You need to be mindful and go through them methodically and carefully.
cues.zh: 必須留意，有條理又仔細地逐項處理。

cues.en: For example, this X to the power of six term here comes from multiplying X to the power of five with x to the power of one.
cues.zh: 例如 x⁶，來自 x⁵ 乘 x¹。

cues.en: So five plus one gives us six.
cues.zh: 五加一得到六。

cues.en: And then for example, this next term here is three X to the power of six times Y and that comes from the minus three.
cues.zh: 再例如下一項 −3x⁶y，來自這個負三。

cues.en: Here is from this minus three multiplied by you could imagine a one over here.
cues.zh: 這個負三乘上這裡可以想像的一。

cues.en: And then we have the x term and then the Y term being multiplied as well.
cues.zh: 再把 x 項與 y 項也乘起來。

cues.en: Any discussion of polynomials naturally leads to a discussion of rational functions.
cues.zh: 談多項式，自然就會談到有理函數。

cues.en: So what is a rational function?
cues.zh: 什麼是有理函數？

cues.en: Well, you know, this word rational means someone who makes sound decisions after weighing all the pros and cons.
cues.zh: 英文 rational 平常是指權衡利弊、做出明智決定的人。

cues.en: It's the opposite of an irrational person.
cues.zh: 和不理性 irrational 相反。

cues.en: But in math, this word actually comes from the word ratio.
cues.zh: 但數學上，這個字其實來自 ratio，比值。

cues.en: So maybe this would be less confusing if we calls these ratio functions instead of rational functions.
cues.zh: 所以如果叫比值函數，也許比有理函數不容易混淆。

cues.en: But anyway, so a rational function is a function that is defined by the ratio of two polynomials.
cues.zh: 總之，有理函數是兩個多項式比值所定義的函數。

cues.en: So the general form looks like this P divided by Q where P and Q are both polynomial functions.
cues.zh: 一般形式是 P/Q，P 和 Q 都是多項式函數。

cues.en: So we could also rewrite this in this summation notation.
cues.zh: 也能改寫成這種求和記號。

cues.en: Oh, and by the way, you've probably also heard of rational numbers.
cues.zh: 順帶一提，你可能也聽過有理數。

cues.en: Irrational number is the same thing as rational function, just that these would be two numbers instead of two functions.
cues.zh: 有理數和有理函數類似，只是這裡是兩個數，而不是兩個函數。

cues.en: So you can also imagine that a rational number comes from a rational function at one point.
cues.zh: 也能把有理數想成有理函數在某個點的值。

cues.en: So one specific value of x, you'll see lots of rational functions in calculus and in particular in
cues.zh: 就是某個特定 x；微積分會看到很多有理函數，尤其在，

cues.en: math applications like time series filtering, calculating the speed of airplanes, work rates and so on.
cues.zh: 時間序列濾波、計算飛機速度、工作速率等數學應用。

cues.en: Polynomials are super easy to work with in differential and integral calculus.
cues.zh: 在微分與積分裡，多項式非常容易操作。

cues.en: They have lots of great properties like continuity and smoothness and all this stuff you learn throughout the course.
cues.zh: 有很多好特性，例如連續、光滑，以及課程會學的各種性質。

cues.en: So applied mathematicians try to use polynomials whenever possible because they have nice properties and because they're easy to work with.
cues.zh: 所以應用數學家盡可能使用多項式，因為特性好，也容易操作。

cues.en: So in this video you learned about polynomial functions.
cues.zh: 這支學了多項式函數。

cues.en: Polynomials are a foundational family of equations that are used in basically every area of math and applications.
cues.zh: 多項式是基礎的方程式家族，基本上用於數學和應用的每個領域。

cues.zh: 接下來兩支，會有機會在 Python 寫程式、視覺化，進一步探索多項式。
